comment: CSDGM has no dataset identifier. A DOI among the citation's online linkages is the @id (https://doi.org/<doi>); else the identifier the caller gives (--identifier: the DataONE identifier, the WAF file name); else the first online linkage.
A PropertyValue: propertyID the identifiers.org doi entry. Without a DOI, the caller's identifier.
The first online linkage: usually the landing page. With none, schema:url is the OGC nil URI.
LinkRoles (linkRelationship 'online linkage') to the other linkages that are not also a download URL in distinfo.

Each originator in order, as a JSON-LD @list. CSDGM gives only a name: 'Family, Initials' (Blodgett, R.B.) or two to four capitalised words with no organisation word (B.E. Dieter, Karen A. Westphal) make a Person; anything else (Amador County, NRCS) an Organization.
As written ('vector digital data', 'tabular digital data').
YYYYMMDD becomes YYYY-MM-DD; a year stays a year; 'Unknown' is dropped.
CSDGM has no revision date for the data: the publication date stands in, as in the ISO converter.
Else the metadata date.
Else a year alone padded to YYYY-01-01. With no date, dateModified is the sentinel 1900-01-01.
The catalog record's date.
The abstract, then the purpose, supplemental information and the entity and attribute overview, each labelled.
rngdates as an ISO 8601 interval (begdate/enddate, with begtime/endtime); each sngdate or mdattim caldate as a date. 'Present' ends an open interval; 'Unknown' is dropped.
A Place with a GeoShape box (S W N E), or GeoCoordinates when the box has no extent; descgeog is its description.

A DefinedTerm in the set's thesaurus (themekt, placekt, stratkt, tempkt) when it names one (not None), described by its keyword type; a name under three characters (GC) is also its termCode, as in the ISO converter. Else a string.
Each taxon a DefinedTerm: taxonrv its name, the rank (taxonrn) its description, common names its alternateName.

The access constraints, then the use constraints, labelled; 'None' is kept, since it states that there are none. CSDGM has no licence element; a Creative Commons or SPDX URL in the use constraints is also schema:license (next row).
A creativecommons.org, opendatacommons.org or spdx.org URL written in the use constraints, as a CreativeWork.
A schema:Role with roleName pointOfContact.
As the ISO converter does for a distributor.
cntinfo: a cntperp is a Person (cntper, affiliated to cntorg), a cntorgp an Organization (cntorg); cntpos is the jobTitle, cntemail and cntvoice the email and telephone.
Each process step a cdifProv Action: procdesc its actionProcess, procdate its endTime, the process contact its agent.
Each source citation as a labelled link (title and first onlink), or its title when it has no link.
A LinkRole (linkRelationship 'crossReference') to each cross-referenced citation with an online linkage, named by its title.
A LinkRole (linkRelationship 'largerWork') when the larger work has an online linkage.
A DataDownload per network resource name (networkr): formname is its encodingFormat, transize (MB) its contentSize. A digital form with no network address is skipped.

Each attribute a cdi:InstanceVariable: attrlabl its name, attrdef its description, the range domain's minimum, maximum and unit its minValue, maxValue and unitText. Identified as #<attrlabl>, prefixed with the entity type's position when there are several.
Enumerated values are not converted yet.
Spatial reference and data organization (projection, datum, raster or vector type) are not converted yet.
No CDIF property; not converted.
Esri, ORNL Mercury and USGS ERP blocks are not converted.
